## Summary
- New `clean.py chapter-flags` subcommand. It adds a red conditional format to just the City cell on Form Responses, and to the `City (Existing)` cell on Organizers, Hosts and Speakers, whenever the submitted city starts with `Other`, in any case.
- The flag does not depend on Status or on `Resolved City` extraction. An `Other` selection asks for a chapter decision; it does not make one.
- Preview is read-only by default and says per tab whether `--write` would change anything. That includes a rule whose stored range stops short of the tab: Sheets fixes the range at the row count when the rule is installed, so it would miss rows Forms adds later.
- `--write` replaces only the rules it owns (same formula, single cell column, red), then reads them back and aborts if the check fails.
- `install-colors` never puts its provenance rules above the flag, and its colour-only fallback no longer mistakes the flag for the error rule.
- Formatting only. No cell values, role-tab formulas or chapters change.
- `SKILL.md`, `WORKFLOW.md` and CHANGELOG are updated, and the City-overwrite rule now names its one exception.

## Test plan
- [x] `python skills/aaif-clean-data/scripts/test_clean.py` (116 tests OK)
- [x] pre-commit on the changed files, plus the PII, retry and banner guards
- [x] Read-only live preview, 2026-10-02: role-tab Other counts add up to the Form Responses count, and every tab reports the rule as current
- [x] The rule is already on the live sheet, so nothing is left to write after merge
